NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Casa·Orquesta uses the microphone so you can talk to your real-estate advisor instead of typing. It only turns on when you tap to speak.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: We turn your voice into text so you can see what you said and we can understand what you're looking for.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Casa·Orquesta may use the camera to verify identity or capture property documents when you request it.
NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: We notify you when an agent confirms a showing or there's an update on a property you follow.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to order property visits and calculate driving routes. Only while you use maps or tours.
